newsitem.title: USA: CME sets Nov 25 launch for Euroyen packs, bundles.
newsitem.headline: CME sets Nov 25 launch for Euroyen packs, bundles.

text.p: The Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME) has set a November 25 launch for packs and bundles for its Euroyen futures contract.

At its November 6 meeting, the CME board approved listing one-, two- and three-year bundles and red and green packs to assist hedging activities in Euroyen strips, according to a members' newsletter distributed on the trading floor.
Packs and bundles are varying combinations of contract months down the curve used for hedge and swap transactions.
Red and green are the color designations given to the second and third years, respectively, listed in the contract.
The CME launched Euroyen futures last March.
The CME board also approved adding two more serial month options to its one-year Eurodollar mid-curve contract, pending Commodity Futures Trading Commission approval.

On December 2, CME plans to add midcurve options expiring in January 1997 and February 1997, both of which are based on the underlying March 1998 Eurodollar futures. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
